title: Error Propagation Theory for Variational Non-Markovian Open Quantum Dynamics
summary: Variational approaches based on neural quantum states and physics-informed neural networks provide powerful paradigms for simulating non-Markovian open quantum dynamics. However, extending these methods into the strongly non-Markovian regime reveals a critical bottleneck: even minute errors in the time evolution can translate into substantial deviations in physical observables. The fundamental origin of this stringent precision requirement, as well as how non-Markovianity governs it, remains an open question.
